unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Axis labeled 'spatial1', an arbitrary spatial coordinate for the tissue section (Visium spot position); no physical unit applies.
Axis labeled 'spatial2', an arbitrary spatial coordinate for the tissue section; no physical unit applies.
Color scale ranges 0.0–1.0 representing a dimensionless cell-type deconvolution score/proportion; no unit needed for this normalized score.
Categorical axis listing immune cell population names (Classical monocyte, Alveolar macrophage, Leukocyte, Non-classical monocyte); no unit applies to category labels.
Standard GSEA enrichment-plot x-axis represents rank order of genes in the ranked list; an index/order value that does not require a physical unit.
Axis labeled 'Enrichment score (ES)', a dimensionless statistic defined by the GSEA method; no additional unit needed.
Categorical axis listing gene names (Arg1, Il1r2, Gpnmb, etc.); no unit applies.
Axis labeled 'Log2 (fold change)', a dimensionless log-ratio; no additional unit needed.

explanation.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot with axes.
